content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from folkativeSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog infolkativeVerified•FollowMore optionsfolkativeVerified 1wSaudi Arabia has officially declared that Eid al-Fitr 1447 AH will fall on Friday, March 20, 2026, after moon-sighting observations confirmed that the Shawwal crescent moon (hilal) was not visible on the evening of Wednesday, March 18, 2026. As a result, this year’s Ramadan will be completed as a 30-day month, with Thursday marking the final day of fasting before Eid. The Eid prayer in Saudi Arabia is scheduled to take place around 15 minutes after sunrise. The decision has also been followed by several other Gulf countries, including United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and Bahrain, which likewise announced Friday, March 20, 2026 as the first day of Eid al-Fitr.
